listing.name: Super Metroid Recompiled
listing.summary: Native Super Metroid recompilation with an exact original and pinned Windows runtime.

steps.title: Preserve the older copy and exact original
steps.instruction: Use your own exact unchanged headerless Super Metroid (Japan, USA) original, SHA-256 12b77c4bc9c1832cee8881244659065ee1d84c70c3d29e6eaf92e6798cc2ca72. Keep the original unchanged outside the new player folder and place a matching copy named game.sfc in that folder. A headered, modified or other-region file is a different input. No original is supplied or downloaded; upstream handles its input recognition. Portcove registration does not authenticate this original or package. Keep every older runtime and its complete data separately; these instructions do not upgrade or adopt them.

steps.title: Prepare the separate Preview player
steps.instruction: Open the linked v0.3.16 Preview release page and use its official Windows x64 ZIP in a new writable folder. Keep SuperMetroidSNESRecomp.exe, packaged config.ini, assets, framework pins, notices and all other companions together inside supermetroid-0.3.16-windows-x64. Use the packaged defaults without old configuration, states, mods, donor assets or developer/path overrides. Finish upstream setup deliberately. Register that folder’s SuperMetroidSNESRecomp.exe with the same containing folder as working directory and two literal argument lines: --rom then game.sfc. Do not select replay_diagnostic.py or a source/build helper as the player.

steps.title: Choose Play and manage updates through the project
steps.instruction: You and upstream own this external package and its data. Play is explicit; removing its Portcove registration preserves the external files. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and external deletion are unavailable for this copy. Settings changes can restart into a successor game window while the initial registered process exits. Do not rely on that initial process’s completion as proof that every game copy has stopped: close all windows/processes before copying or replacing runtime or data. Keep the shipped PolyForm Noncommercial and dependency notices; do not run Generate & rebuild, debug/replay helpers or extra mods as part of these instructions. A Portcove library containing any managed installation of this identity cannot also attach this external copy. Keep that managed installation and use the new upstream copy directly, or register only in a separate library with no managed installation, other registration or pending launch for this identity. Do not remove an older managed runtime or kept data just to enable registration.

warnings: This guide is bounded to the linked upstream v0.3.16 Preview. The existing managed package policy remains unchanged. Other builds need their own source, setup, data and lifetime assessment.

Snapshot identity checks and rejection before launch do not establish compatibility with old states, adoption of populated data or complete managed maintenance. Preserve older runtimes and all their data.

Preserve the whole new folder, its original copy, configuration, SRAM, states, screenshots, mods manifests and logs/replay sidecars with all game copies closed. Do not copy old states, save folders or profiles into it, share data folders with the old runtime, or point --config at retained data.
A separate Preview download or changed launch argument does not prove old/new state compatibility or migrate progress. Keep the creating runtime for every existing state.

source_requirements.label: Super Metroid (Japan, USA) exact headerless SNES original

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own exact unchanged headerless Super Metroid (Japan, USA) original. The managed route selects compatible official Windows packages, a SHA256-checked game.sfc copy beside the executable, and direct --rom game.sfc with the startup launcher disabled. Backups include that private original copy. Historical installations without the partitioned-data contract retain their creating rules and remain held for a separate reviewed transition. Existing installations keep their creating runtime and exact contract. Host snapshots are build-specific; this route proves no old/new state compatibility or gameplay. The installation folder needs basic Latin characters and a short path. Keep config.local.ini absent and developer, oracle, replay-playback and custom path modes disabled. Default settings, keybindings, SRAM, states, screenshots, sm-video.ini and its temporary companion, selected mod state and logs are managed; packaged mod manifests, assets, libraries and notices stay immutable. Fresh upstream Widescreen/Fit and experimental optional enhancements are not full-game fidelity acceptance. The optional Zero Mission map-art route requires separately owned donor input and is unused here; extra mods and donor assets need separate qualification. Default diagnostic recording stays enabled: logs contain game memory, inputs, build/original identities, settings and possibly private local paths. No automatic upload occurs; share only deliberately and keep replay sidecars together. Each session retains at most one hour/360 segments and 256 MiB of checkpoint bytes; old sessions accumulate. SM_REPLAY_RECORD=0 is an optional user opt-out. A read-only installation can fall back to %TEMP%/SuperMetroidSNESRecomp/logs outside managed backup/removal. Preserve upstream PolyForm Noncommercial and dependency notices; game originals and donor artwork are not included.
